'''Lar-Odo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] who frequently played [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] at the [[The White Door|White Door Cantina]] in [[Akmalla]] with the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jokot]] and the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bonna Noot]].
